## Why This Is Asked

Assesses ability to map cross-functional incentives, negotiate without formal authority, and coordinate across remote, time-zone-distributed teams. Tests practical steps to gain buy-in and drive adoption with measurable outcomes.

## Key Concepts

- Stakeholder mapping across functions
- Negotiation with limited formal authority
- Remote collaboration and time-zone logistics
- Artifact creation: RACI, rollout plan, success metrics

## Code Example

```javascript

const map = [
  {name:'Eng', incentive:'reduce overhead', levers:['shorten review cycles']},

  {name:'UX', incentive:'quality design', levers:['design tokens']},
  {name:'Legal', incentive:'compliance', levers:['policy alignment']},
];
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you handle a stakeholder who refuses to participate?
- What metrics would you track to show ROI of standardized reviews?
